The country club pays less than the house across the street.

Get Involved

Read Council File 26-0705→ Submit a public comment→ Ask your neighborhood council→ See the numbers→ Read the coverage→

Twelve private clubs sit on three square miles of the most valuable land in America.

They pay, all together, about a quarter of what the Century City mall pays. Proposition 13, a 1960 golf-course rule and a 1985 court case explain why. Public access: members and their guests.
